title: Default Gateway Operation and Troubleshooting
summary: Master the role of the default gateway in local versus remote packet forwarding, and systematically diagnose missing, incorrect, and unreachable gateway configurations.
learning_objectives: Explain the purpose of a default gateway for inter-subnet communication.
Contrast local intra-subnet delivery via direct ARP with remote delivery via default gateway MAC forwarding.
Diagnose and isolate symptoms of a missing default gateway on a host.
Troubleshoot incorrect default gateway IP configurations using ping and ipconfig.
Investigate network reachability failures caused by downed router gateway interfaces.
